Easter at home — simple & reverent

Little ones catch tone before theology. Keep it short, true, and calm—same KJV you use elsewhere on the site.

  • Luke 24:6 — “He is not here, but is risen.” Let them echo the last four words after you.
  • John 11:25 — “Jesus said unto her, I am the resurrection, and the life: he that believeth in me, though he were dead, yet shall he live.”
  • Matthew 28:6 — “He is not here: for he is risen, as he said. Come, see the place where the Lord lay.”

One calm idea: Step outside together (porch or yard). Name one hard or “dead” thing from the week—then thank God out loud that Jesus is alive. One minute, no lecture. For read-aloud with older kids, use He is risen or walk through Resurrection Hope one day at a time.
